title: Government Entity Coverage Audit
description: A coverage snapshot measuring how completely a denominator universe (e.g. the 78 municipalities, all current entities, or a source's entity codes) resolves to canonical government entities (gates MUNICIPALITY_COMPLETE, CURRENT_ENTITY_COMPLETE, SOURCE_CODE_COMPLETE, COVERAGE_REPORT_GENERATED). The denominator source and its hash are required so a percentage can never be reported without a traceable universe. Describes one coverage-audit record.

denominator_source.description: Identity of the authoritative universe (e.g. source_id or document).

source_hash.description: Hash of the denominator-source snapshot (optionally algorithm-prefixed).
